finalText:
Build is clean. Fixed two bugs from the package bump:

1. **options.js** — `resolveRetries` was looking for `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `options.retryCount`. Changed the property name.

2. **retryPolicy.js** — `isBackoffEnabled` threw when the flag was `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Added a check to treat `undefined` the same as `false`.

The remaining warnings in the output are just deprecation noise from Node itself (old APIs, removed modules) — nothing that needs fixing on your side.
